bodies.name: Országgyűlés (National Assembly of Hungary)
bodies.layout: A traditional, text-dense institutional homepage organized into stacked content blocks rather than a modern grid. The top holds a masthead with the Parliament name/crest, followed by an 'Aktuális' (Current/Latest) hero-style news item with a photo and long-form caption text. Below that runs a 'Hírek, események' (News, events) river of thumbnail-plus-headline-plus-summary items, each quite text-heavy in the traditional Hungarian institutional style. Further down are dedicated sections for 'Törvényalkotás' (Legislation) with sub-links to legislative process flowcharts, adopted laws, and house rules, plus a session calendar and a live-stream link. A sidebar/footer area promotes the 'Virtuális Országház' (Virtual Parliament House) tour and the Országház Könyvkiadó (House Publishing) book catalog.

bodies.name: Magyarország Kormánya (Government of Hungary)
bodies.layout: A modern card-based news portal built on kormany.hu's redesigned template (redirects from www.kormany.hu to kormany.hu). The header holds the 'Magyarország Kormánya' logo plus a slim main nav with only three top items (Hírek, Kormányzat, Dokumentumtár) and a persistent 'EN' language-switch link to abouthungary.hu. Below a rotating 'Kiemelt tartalmak' (featured content) bar sits a large hero news card, followed by a three-item 'Kiemelt hírek' (featured news) grid, then a 'Kiemelt témák' (featured topics) module and an embedded YouTube video carousel. The page ends with a 'Legfrissebb hírek' (latest news) list, a newsletter sign-up block, and a dense footer of legal/contact links plus social icons.

bodies.name: Rendőrség (National Police of Hungary / Országos Rendőr-főkapitányság)
bodies.layout: A dense, Drupal 8-powered portal (visible in the page generator meta tag) with a mega-menu menu system covering Hírek és információk, Ügyintézés, and A Rendőrségről, each with dozens of nested sub-links (e.g., per-county 'Vármegye' pages under Távoltartás). A slim top utility bar carries social icons, an accessible-version link, and an emergency 'Bajban van?' (Are you in trouble?) shortcut plus a 'TELEFONTANÚ' hotline number. Below a rotating photo slider sits an 'Aktualitások' (Current affairs) news grid of regional police headquarters reports, followed by a most-wanted persons ('Körözési toplista') photo grid, a 'Zsaru Magazin' (Police Magazine) feature section, and a live-updated border-crossing wait-time and illegal-migration statistics widget. The footer repeats the mega-menu structure in condensed link columns.
